name: hold-to-maximum-button
intent: Hold OUTPUT to fill a dashed-track charge ring with notches; at 100% accent overload ticks commit maximum output.

input.hold: Pointer hold or Space/Enter key hold on OUTPUT button

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip charge ramp; immediately show 100% accent ring and MAXIMUM OUTPUT

acceptance: Idle: 0% with dashed track, cardinal notches, empty primary ring
Hold (pointer or Space/Enter) fills ring over 1200ms with 40ms percent ticks
Quadrant notches brighten from 75%; overload accent ticks appear at 90%+
Release before 100% resets to idle and announces charge released
100% commits accent ring, overload ticks, MAXIMUM OUTPUT, disabled button
Visually distinct from cooldown ring: dashed track, butt caps, charge notches (not drain)
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) jumps to committed state
No network; effect stays inside host
